title: OpenAI.UnprocessableEntityError(422) when AssistantAgent invokes multiple tool calls
author: besthunterhj

comments.author: ekzhu
comments.body: @besthunterhj does the latest version also have this issue for you? I tested your code with 0.6.4 but I can't reproduce your error

comments.author: besthunterhj
comments.body: @ekzhu Thank you for your support! I have upgraded to the latest version (0.6.4); The same issue occurs when I run the code above. However, I found that the issue can be solved by changing **line 273** in `_set_null_content_for_tool_calls()` to `return {"content": ""}` in `python/packages/autogen-ext/src/autogen_ext/models/openai/_message_transform.py` from the branch `copilot/fix-6788`.

comments.author: ekzhu
comments.body: @besthunterhj  I tried running your script and still cannot get the error. What is the API endpoint you are using, is it OpenAI?

comments.author: besthunterhj
comments.body: @ekzhu Hi! Actually, I use an alternative endpoint rather than the official OpenAI API endpoint, which might be the source of the issue.
